svg.aria-label: Example of a verified diagram: the order flow of a small sample repository. Four phases: place order, add photo, nightly close, report. Lanes for people and apps, backend, jobs and services, storage, data via link, and external services. Every box shows its file and line; boxes the code cannot confirm are dotted. Two zoom panels show the steps of the report service and the nightly job, who decides each step, and the risks found in the code.
svg.title: Example of a verified diagram
svg.text: Refs: main (export of 2026-11-13). Drawn 2026-11-13. Every box shows its file and line.
No AI step: code decides every step.
Risk: links may not resolve (PHOTOS is in memory, orders.py:2).
Risk: unknown order id fails (:5); no timeout (:6).
No AI step: code decides every step.
Risk: mail before close; a failed close mails twice (:6-7).
Risk: one send error stops the loop. Caller not confirmed.
APP: a person, an app or plain code
DATA: a store or a table
dashed: test only or branch only
r/w and two heads: the part reads and writes that store. Teal: store traffic. Beams sit behind the boxes.
